title: autotune: default batching/caching + quant profiles + unit-econ tooling
author: Michael Chen
description: Motivation: reduce per-token unit economics for common workloads by automatically recommending and applying safe batching/caching defaults and model quantization profiles while giving teams visibility into expected cost impact. This PR implements an autotune pipeline that (1) observes request distributions, (2) simulates batching and KV-cache hit improvements, (3) scores candidate quantization profiles against accuracy/regression constraints, and (4) surfaces recommended defaults and expected unit-econ impact in the Console and via the API. Summary of changes: added an autotune controller and scheduler in runtime/autotune that collects telemetry and runs lightweight simulations; new batching policy heuristics with per-tenant defaults and time-windowed adaptation; prefix/KV cache defaulting and TTL heuristics with safe rollbacks; quantization profile registry and offline validation harness to evaluate error bounds for common tasks; Console UI and API endpoints for unit economics reports and one-click apply/rollback; CLI tooling for running local dry-runs; instrumentation and export of new metrics (uecon.estimated_savings, autotune.recommendation_confidence, quant.validation_regression) and tracing hooks; feature-flag gating and staged rollout plan. Backwards compatibility: all changes are opt-in behind feature flag "autotune-cost-optimizer"; default recommendations are read-only until a tenant explicitly applies them. For Automatic rollouts we use a conservative default and require approval for applying quantized models in Dedicated/private clusters. Testing: unit tests for batching heuristics, integration tests for simulation pipeline, e2e smoke in perf-canary with representative workloads, and offline evals using existing eval-harness; CI flakiness observed on first run (lint on yaml) fixed in follow-up commit. Deployment/rollout: feature flag rollout staggered over 2 weeks, initial cohort = internal beta customers, canary on a single Dedicated pool then expand. Security/review notes: quant profiles validated against model integrity checks and pinned artifact hashes; no secret material introduced. Related linear tickets: ENG-3467 autotune controller design, ENG-3499 quant profile onboarding, PM-212 unit-econ console work. Checklist: [x] design doc linked in ENG-3467 [x] unit tests [x] integration tests [x] console UI mockups attached [x] docs updated
commits: add autotune controller and scheduler; implement batching heuristics and cache defaults; add quant profile registry and offline validator; add Console UI for unit-econ reports; add API endpoints for recommendations; add CLI dry-run tooling; fix linting issue in yaml manifests; update docs

release_notes: Introduces an autotune pipeline that recommends batching, caching, and quantization defaults based on observed workload patterns
Adds quantization profile registry with offline validation to estimate accuracy impact
Adds Unit Economics tooling in Console and API: estimated savings, confidence scores, and one-click apply/rollback
Feature-gated rollout; no breaking changes expected
